model: Selecting a restaurant that was already in the loaded list copied the whole list into a new swipe array. That new array also threw away the viewport cell index. The same list is now returned, so neither the copy nor the index rebuild happens. A restaurant that is not in the list is still appended.

noise.rule: One copy of the loaded list per selection of an already listed restaurant. The copy length is the loaded restaurant count. Not a sampled heap trace.
